description: This file defines logging event IDs, event names, and high-performance logging message templates for the PDFsharp library, specifically related to PDF document and page events, as well as PDF reading issues.

classes.name: PdfSharpEventId
classes.description: Contains constant integer values representing different event IDs for logging within PDFsharp.

classes.name: PdfSharpEventName
classes.description: Contains string constants representing event names for logging events in PDFsharp.

classes.name: PdfSharpEvent
classes.description: Defines EventId objects combining event IDs and names for PDFsharp logging.

classes.name: LogMessages
classes.description: Provides static partial methods with LoggerMessage attribute for high-performance logging of various PDFsharp events and issues.

methods.name: PdfDocumentCreated
methods.description: Logs the creation of a new PDF document with the specified document name.

methods.name: PdfDocumentSaved
methods.description: Logs the saving of a PDF document with the specified document name.

methods.name: NewPdfPageCreated
methods.description: Logs the creation of a new PDF page in a document.

methods.name: ExistingPdfPageAdded
methods.description: Logs the addition of an existing PDF page to a document.

methods.name: XGraphicsCreated
methods.description: Logs the creation of a new XGraphics object from a source.

methods.name: StreamIssue
methods.description: Logs an error with stream content, indicating the status, bytes read, and total length.

methods.name: EndOfStreamReached
methods.description: Logs a warning when the end of a stream is reached prematurely during reading.

methods.name: SkippedIllegalBlanksAfterStreamKeyword
methods.description: Logs a warning after skipping illegal blanks following the 'stream' keyword.

methods.name: StreamKeywordFollowedBySingleCR
methods.description: Logs a warning if the 'stream' keyword is followed by a single CR, which is illegal.

methods.name: StreamKeywordFollowedByIllegalBytes
methods.description: Logs a warning if the 'stream' keyword is followed by illegal bytes.
